about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply: Since you like gigs and going out, you might enjoy [[Music]] for playing and performing.

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: [[Book]] and [[Film]] are great choices for a quiet night in with a story.

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply: For football and staying active, you might like [[Cycling]] or [[Climbing]].

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: For films and the cinema, you might like [[Film]].

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: [[Gaming and Roleplay]] and [[Esports]] are great for gaming with others.

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: If you love going out, [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] are great places to check out.

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: [[Climbing]] is a great choice if you enjoy climbing, and [[Walking]] is perfect for long walks outdoors.

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply: For birdwatching and nature trips, [[Walking]] is a great choice to get outdoors.

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Since you aren't into sports, clubbing or gaming, what sorts of things do you enjoy doing in your spare time?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: [[Book]], [[Film]] and [[Comic Book]] might suit you well for cosy nights in and good stories.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply: [[Rock]] is great for finding people who are into live music and gigs.

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: [[Ukrainian]] is open to everyone, so it is a great place to learn about the culture and meet people.

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: [[Mature Students]] is a great choice to meet others who started uni a bit later on.

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: I am sorry to hear you are worried about money, but there is support available. [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] can help with food and money worries.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I'm really sorry to hear that. You can get support with food and money through [[Food Pantry]] and [[Cost of Location]].

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: I am so sorry you are going through that, but please try not to panic. You can get support from the [[Advice Centre]], which helps students with academic misconduct and appeals.

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply: Yes, you can make a complaint about housing issues. [[Advice Centre]] can help and advise you on how to handle this with your landlord.

swims a lot.message: I swim a lot and I'd like to keep it up while I'm here. Any clubs or societies?
swims a lot.reply: [[Swimming]] has the memberships and who to contact.

played football at school.message: I played football at school and I'd like to start playing again. Where should I look?
played football at school.reply: You can join [[Football]] for training and matches.

into ice hockey.message: I'm really into ice hockey. Is there anything for me here?
into ice hockey.reply: There is an [[Ice Hockey]] society you might like.

never done sport, wants to get fit.message: I've never really done any sport, but I want to get fitter this year. Any ideas?
never done sport, wants to get fit.reply: Since you are looking to get fitter, [[Yoga]] and [[Pilates]] are great options to try.

do I pay to see a doctor.message: I'm an international student. Do I have to pay to see a doctor here?
do I pay to see a doctor.reply:
You generally don't have to pay to see a doctor through the NHS once you are registered with a GP. 

[[NHS Guide]]

how does the NHS work.message: I've just arrived from abroad and I don't understand how the NHS works. Can you explain?
how does the NHS work.reply: You can use the [[NHS Guide]] in the app to see how the NHS works, including seeing a doctor and registering with a GP.

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: [[Hooked By Crochet]] and [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] are both great if you love yarn crafts.
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: [[Hooked By Crochet]] has how to join and who to contact.

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply: [[Climbing]] fits if you are looking for indoor sessions and outdoor trips, and [[Outdoor Climbing]] is great if you want to head out onto real rock.
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: [[Climbing]] has how to join and who to contact.

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: [[Gaming and Roleplay]] is for tabletop gaming and roleplaying.
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: [[Gaming and Roleplay]] has how to join and who to contact.

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply: [[Film]] is a great choice if you enjoy watching and talking about movies.
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: [[Film]] has how to join and who to contact.
